entries.o: <fe><02><0a><30><37><32><63><5f><30><30><31><33><00>You went on an adventure?\nTell me about it!
<fe><02><0a><30><37><32><63><5f><30><30><32><31><00>It must be fun traveling\naround the world.

<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>It's peaceful, sure, but\nsomething's not right.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>We've lost contact with\nRosalina Island...
<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>You want to live here?\nYeah, it's a great place.

<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Lately, the demons' pranks\nhave been getting worse.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>Some of them can't even be\nclassified as pranks.
<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>Next time, I'll invite\nyou to dinner.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>I need to thank you for\nprotecting Elendia.
<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>Are we going to live in\nconstant fear of demons?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><33><37><00>I don't think it would\nend at that.
<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><35><32><00>I feel bad about what\nhappened to Rosalina...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><35><33><00>I hope Elendia doesn't\nfollow suit.
<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><36><36><00>Isn't it wonderful to have\na place to come back to?
<fe><02><0a><30><37><33><62><5f><30><30><36><39><00>If there's anything I\ncan do, please, ask.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><61><5f><30><30><38><34><00>Hold on. I'll go get some\nnasty-tasting medicine!
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><61><5f><30><30><39><34><00>I wonder what's for dinner?\nCoCo should hurry up.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><61><5f><30><31><31><32><00>We have to work hard to\nprotect the view here.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>What are you going to do\nabout Rosalina Island?
<fe><02><0a><30><38><32><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>We have no intention of\ncausing you any harm.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><32><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>Those kind of areas are\nthe perfect spot for demons.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><32><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>What've we been fightin'\nall this time for?
<fe><02><0a><30><38><32><62><5f><30><30><34><36><00>This is the house of Graham,\nthe Elder of the village.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>I told you already. It's\nfar too dangerous...

<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>We've lost contact with\nthe Arcs of Rosalina Island.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>What if it was demons...?\nWe have to find out.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>And that makes it okay to\nforget about the Arcs!?
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>Wait... Listen to us, Ein!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>Grandfather cancelled the\nRosalina Island expedition!
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>The people there, the Arcs,\nhave been killed by demons.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>That's not true! We've simply\nlost contact with them...

<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>...But if they really were
attacked...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>We cannot ignore this. The
demons will continue their invasion,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>causing great harm to
all of Riviera.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>Elendia was supposed to\nsend a group to check...
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>It's already been decided.\nThis is the village's decision.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><37><31><00>Lina will go too, so you\ndon't have to worry.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><39><31><00>I heard rumors of demons\nappearing at Tetyth.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><30><37><00>I hear demons wander the\nland even after death.

<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><31><32><00>Marvelous work, Ein.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><31><33><00>You have sealed the final\nAccursed at Mireno.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><31><34><00>I thank you on behalf of\nElendia and all of Riviera.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><32><36><00>I never imagined the demons would\nthink up such an audacious scheme...
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><33><00>I could not imagine that\nit would come to this...

<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><34><00>I always believed that\neverything would be saved...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><35><00>...with the sealing of the\nAccursed.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><36><00>Hector is planning to call\nupon the Sealed One, Seth...

<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><37><00>Oh, how dreadful... With
Ursula's power weakened...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><38><00>If the Sealed One were to
be revived...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><33><39><00>The Retribution would be
inevitable...
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><34><39><00>I learned that from all\nthe villagers here.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><35><36><00>There will be a time for\nus to talk later.
<fe><02><0a><30><38><33><62><5f><30><31><36><34><00>We pray for your safety from\nthe bottom of our hearts.
<fe><02><0e><30><38><33><62><5f><30><30><31><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Magic circle... What are you\nplanning, asking me that?
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><61><5f><30><30><34><34><00>Welcome back. It must've\nbeen a rough trip.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><61><5f><30><30><34><35><00>Fia and Lina were both\npretty beat.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><61><5f><30><31><30><33><00>Huh? They said they were\ngoing to bathe...
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>We washed your clothes,\nsince they were dirty.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><34><33><00>It's our house, so make\nyourself at home.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><35><32><00>A Grim Angel has breached\nour domain: Yggdrasil.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><35><34><00>The Grim Angel is trying\nto destroy the Aquariums,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><35><35><00>the heart of Yggdrasil's\ndefense.

<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><35><37><00>If they are destroyed,
the Sealed One<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><35><38><00>will be able to flow into
the domain of Yggdrasil.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><35><39><00>Our confrontation will surely
end both of our existences.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><36><30><00>Then there will be no one
to prevent the Retribution.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><36><31><00>Ein... This tragedy must be
averted.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><36><32><00>We must protect the
Aquariums at all costs.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><36><36><00>May you have the blessing\nof the gods...

<fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><38><30><00>I understand it may be
disheartening,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><38><31><00>being a stranger in a
foreign town.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><38><32><00>If it's okay with you, please
stay here until you recover.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><38><33><00>By the way, what do you think
of this town so far?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><33><62><5f><30><30><38><34><00>I believe you'll find it's
a wonderful place.
<fe><02><0a><30><39><31><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Grim Angel, have you found\nwhere Ursula is?

<fe><02><0a><30><39><31><61><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Ursula's body lies in the
center of Riviera...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><31><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Somewhere in the domain of
Yggdrasil.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><31><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Continue your search for
the entrance to Yggdrasil.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><39><31><61><5f><30><30><30><36><00>You must work doubly hard
for the dead Grim Angel.

Beyond the curving
pathway lined with
trees lies Elendia,
the town where
Sprites live.

A pathway surrounded
by trees. The soft
rays of light that
seep through bring
peace of mind to all.

Located deep in the
forest by Elendia,
it is always filled
with fresh water.

A beautiful cavern
lined with crystals.
The Magic Guild in
the back has a whole
array of books.

Chappi the Hobbit's
smithery workshop.
His family treasure,
Thor Hammer,forges
many weapons.

Kyle, the Pixia who
likes fishing,
and his wife Mylene
live here with
their children.

The living quarters
of the Elder, Graham.
It is located at the
center of Elendia.

Located on a hill,
the entire town can
be seen from here.
Lina's room is on
the second floor.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Just don't waste any\nitems you find.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>They'll be essential to\nan amateur like you.

<fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>As I thought. They must be
under someone's command.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><34><30><00>But the gods' decision
is absolute...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>You must hurry and
complete your mission.

<fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><35><31><00>Once you pass Heaven's Gate,
you will be on your own.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><35><32><00>I will no longer be able
to contact you.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><35><33><00>I entrust you with this
task...
<fe><02><0a><31><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Where are you going?\nHave you given up?
<fe><02><0a><31><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Hey Ein, is this place\nfilled with demons?
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Alright, I'll teach you\nhow to look around.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>First, look at the bottom\nright of the screen.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>In Move Mode, you can\nmove from place to place.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>Look, the number of times an\nitem can be used is limited!

<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>That's because it's special!\nLedah's Lorelei, too.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><33><00>You saw numbers when you\nselected the Potion, right?
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>That ¤03¤ tells how long\nthe item will last.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>So if I use the Potion\n3 times, it'll be gone?
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>So I better use my items\nmore carefully from now on.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><34><32><00>Now, look at the bottom right\nof the screen.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><34><37><00>When you want to look\naround the room,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><34><38><00>press the © button to\nswitch to Look Mode.

<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><32><00>Look Mode differs from\nMove Mode...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><33><00>When the Trigger Icon appears,\npress the directional buttons.

<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><35><00>It'll be displayed in
the middle of the screen.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><36><00>By pressing the directional
buttons,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><37><00>you'll be able to look
around the room.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><35><38><00>I don't really get it,\nbut it sounds useful.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><36><31><00>So press the directional buttons\nwhen the icon appears...
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><36><32><00>Once we drop down,\nthere's no coming back...
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><39><39><00>There's a ledge below.\nWe can drop down from here.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><37><38><00>There's a ledge below.\nWe can drop down from here.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><37><39><00>See? Looking around can\nlead to new discoveries!
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><38><31><00>You won't notice these\nthings just walking around.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><38><33><00>Oh, but there's something\nI forgot to tell you...

<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><39><30><00>Well, just remember you'll\nneed them to look around.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><39><31><00>If you don't have any,\nthen you can't look around.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><39><32><00>How am I supposed to know\nif I have any or not?
<fe><02><0c><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><39><35><5f><61><00>Is there any way to get\nmore Trigger Points?
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><30><39><37><00>and by getting a good\nscore in battle.
<fe><02><0a><31><31><34><62><5f><30><31><30><30><00>Press the § button to\nswitch back to Move Mode.
<fe><02><0e><31><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Remember, you can't use\nitems you haven't selected!
<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><61><5f><30><30><31><37><00>A Mana Wisp is a ball of\nenergy and light,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><32><61><5f><30><30><31><38><00>formed from the power\nof the Sprites.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><61><5f><30><30><32><31><00>That power will be yours\nif you touch it.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><61><5f><30><30><32><39><00>Huh? I thought there was\na Mana Wisp here.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><61><5f><30><30><33><34><00>Nope. You should've\nlistened to me.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><32><61><5f><30><30><33><35><00>Always touch one when\nyou have the chance.

<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Did this place use to\nbe a temple...?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Heaven's Gate just keeps\ngetting more interesting.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Make sure you check stuff\nlike this in Look Mode...
<fe><02><0a><31><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Wow! You actually listened\nto me for a change.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Enough chatter. For now,\npractice using Normal Skills.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>It's useless... No matter\nhow hard you try,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>you won't be able to\nmaster an Over Skill.

<fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>Look, it depends on\nthe user and the item...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>Not everyone can learn\na skill with every item.
<fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>Check to see if there's\na meter or not.
